resources.string: Boot seat: partitions + the ramdisk’s own init

The partitions are presented as devices (by-name nodes, a real mount table) in every boot mode, and a boot runs the boot image ramdisk’s /init as the first guest process — it sets up and hands over itself, like on a device — instead of the host’s service plan. For images imported with this build (their boot image is kept). Experimental; applies at the next full boot.
